faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Lakhisarai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DLSA Lakhisarai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 100 vacancies for Para Legal Volunteer (PLV).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DLSA Lakhisarai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed form Prapatra-Ka on page 3 of this PDF; interview letter Prapatra-Kha on page 4) and send it to Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court Campus, Lakhisarai, PIN 811311, by registered post only, to reach by 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is above 21 years (as on 21 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Honorarium of Rs. 750 per working day after evaluation of work done.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Minimum Matric pass with good knowledge of writing English and Hindi; permanent resident of Lakhisarai district.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a permanent resident of Lakhisarai district. Good knowledge of writing English and Hindi. Retired employees, SHG workers, Anganwadi Sevika, NGO workers, students, teachers, doctors and senior citizens of Lakhisarai district may apply. Men and women interested in working without financial gain for weaker and deprived sections may apply.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Advocates are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. 100 PLVs to be empanelled after interview. Interview at the chamber of the Chairman / Secretary, DLSA Lakhisarai. All original documents must be brought at the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure of one year; tenure may be extended. Selection is not appointment to a government job. PLVs work voluntarily without any profit.
